speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging and spirometry results strongly suggest a restrictive lung disease, likely pulmonary fibrosis. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) The combination of a 6-week history of progressive dyspnea, restrictive spirometry (low FEV1/FVC ratio), and bilateral interstitial markings on the chest X-ray, in the absence of systemic autoimmune symptoms like joint pain or rash, strongly points to Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis. The presence of white sputum is non-specific but does not rule out this diagnosis. Do you have any family history of lung disease, and have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or heartburn recently?
